variants.headline: Still in view: a company goes under
variants.sub: The colony has seen a company fail.
variants.body:
Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement. A company has gone under in {colony}.

We judge {target} critically. Business failure deserves more than a shrug, and the standards of stewardship should be examined rather than dismissed as irrelevant once an enterprise has gone under.
